subject: Calculate effective sample size of both latent factors in GWAS by subtraction

messages.author: 4d3f334959f8f988
messages.subject: Calculate effective sample size of both latent factors in GWAS by subtraction
parts:
Hi there,

I am applying GWAS by subtraction as in https://rpubs.com/MichelNivard/565885. In my scenario I have two latent factor model (F1, F2) in which F1 is specific for a trait1 and F2 for trait1,trait2,trait3,trait4. 
Following https://github.com/PerlineDemange/non-cognitive/blob/master/GenomicSEM/Cholesky%20model/Calculation_samplesize.R 
I calculate my F1 ESS easily. For F2 I can understand I should remove unstand path loading of trait1, but I was questioning how to treat the other three and so how to calculate residual heritability of F2. Should I use heritability of single traits, their factor loadings and their correlation to calculate F2 residual heritability or should I use different methods?

Thank you so much
